notes.title: MAINTENANCE UPDATE #2
notes.content:
It’s not just a minor relief, but a real weight lifted off our shoulders. It caused many sleepless (and nightmare-filled) nights, but we are pleased to announce that we have fixed the hit registration loss bug that occurred around Day 15 - you should not encounter it anymore.

For the full change log, please refer to the patch-notes channel on our Discord channel:
https://discord.gg/wQsGWZgM5N
